sources.entry: 18. Nexmo API - APIs for messaging, voice, and phone verification.

summary.name: Vonage Communications APIs
summary.one_liner: Vonage Communications APIs (formerly Nexmo) is a set of programmable APIs for messaging, voice, video, and fraud protection across global channels.
use_cases: sending branded SMS, RCS, and WhatsApp messages to customers
adding programmable voice calls to an application
building live video sessions into an app
phone number and customer identity verification
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Vonage Communications APIs as programmable APIs for reaching customers across channels including RCS, SMS, WhatsApp, email, voice, and video. Its main product areas are Messaging, Voice API, Video API, and Fraud Protection (Verify, Identity Insights, and Fraud Defender). It states the APIs are hosted on AWS and cover nearly 200 countries and 2,000+ networks. It also mentions developer resources, free evaluation trials, and no-code/low-code tools. Most of the page is marketing and analyst-report claims, with few concrete technical details.
notable: Formerly Nexmo; covers messaging, voice, video, and fraud protection in one platform
Hosted on AWS, reaching nearly 200 countries and 2,000+ networks
Offers free evaluation trials and no-code/low-code tools
caveats: Page mentions free evaluation trials but does not give specific paid tier prices
Much of the content is marketing and analyst recognition rather than technical specifics
